description: Main source file for a Flutter application tailored for Android TV. It sets up app routing, theme, and custom focusable widgets to support TV navigation with DPAD and activate actions.

classes.name: ActivateIntent
classes.description: Custom Intent class to trigger activation actions from TV remote keys.

classes.name: TvFocusable
classes.description: A custom widget that wraps focusable elements to provide highlight and activation behavior for TV remote navigation.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the login screen with focus navigation for username, password, and login button.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Stateless widget representing a placeholder home screen.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the Flutter application that initializes and runs MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Overrides for widget build methods in MyApp, TvFocusable, LoginScreen, and HomeScreen to define UI layout.
